rolled_rounds.note: Xoodoo.permute runs its 12 rounds as a runtime loop over the round constants instead of an inline for that the compiler fully unrolls, so programs carry one copy of the round instead of twelve. Output is unchanged; the trade is speed (the ReleaseFast workloads run about 11 to 13 percent more instructions, measured before writing this note), which is what a size-first build of a library for memory-constrained devices asks for.
